delta_from_native_v6: Single-packet512word buffer becomes variable-length committed multi-packet FIFO in same dual-port RAM.
Exact payload length accumulated during existing numeric validation scan; no extra pass or new popcount tree.
Wrapper starts raw copy against producer fill token, not older queued head token.

queue_contract.producer: One exact-sized reservation and incomplete fill at a time. Filling writes do not advance committed pointer until producer_done and exact count.
queue_contract.consumer: Head descriptor read from committed records. Headers free credits after latching, payload words only after accepted GPU handshakes. Independent fill/drain may overlap.
queue_contract.reset: Consumer reset discards every queued/partial packet together with GPU bridge, cancels/drains current mesh DMA; unrelated legacy raw DMA survives.
queue_contract.fault: Wrong length or extra producer data halts without committing partial tail; no partial tail becomes visible. Full marker context must match decoded head.
queue_contract.known_protocol_delay: When new ARM reserves behind old READY head, a wrong new marker can have mismatch suppressed for the reservation cycle; next cycle faults without acceptance. wrapper-v7b proves bounded rejection. Optional !queue_busy hardening deferred per parent to preserve measurement.
